title: Anagram Detective
summary: Chunk the letters into common word parts and shuffle them.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Rearrange the letters of LISTEN to make another common word.
points: Rearrange the letters of LISTEN to make another common word.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: An anagram uses exactly the same letters in a new order.
Do not guess wildly. Look for common endings and starts.
points: An anagram uses exactly the same letters in a new order.

steps.title: The method: Chunk and shuffle
sentences: Look for chunks such as ING, ER, EST or TION.
Write the letters in a circle and try different starts.
LISTEN contains the chunk TEN, and also IN.
points: Look for chunks such as ING, ER, EST or TION.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: LISTEN can be rearranged into SILENT, and also ENLIST and TINSEL.
EARTH can become HEART or HATER.
points: LISTEN can be rearranged into SILENT, and also ENLIST and TINSEL.

quiz.q: Which word is an anagram of STOP?
quiz.why: POTS uses S, T, O, P.
